thread:
Asha Rao: Fyi - Solstice Labs wants countersigned MSA + signed orderform before we spin up the POC. Key asks: invoices to their EU subsidiary, BYOK/HSM attestation, net45, and they may use a delegated EU signatory. Can legal/finance accept a proxy signer? :thinking:

Priya Rao: Short answer: yes, with conditions. We need a delegation letter or POA and a registry lookup showing the delegating authority. If signer not listed, require notarized POA or board resolution. Also need to know which legal entity will receive the invoices.

Jordan Kim: Finance: net45 is ok provided a formal PO is submitted and credit review passes. If procurement is slow, offer proforma/prepay to unblock provisioning. Who is the invoice recipient and VAT number?

Asha Rao: Uploading files: https://drive.redwood.example/Solstice_Orderform_v1.pdf and Solstice_MSA_redline.docx. Customer says invoices go to "Solstice EU SARL" (VAT EU-SL-9922). Procurement says PO ~10 biz days.

Arun Patel: Ops note: they asked for 99.99% uptime as well. That requires multi-region Dedicated + active failover and adds significant cost. We can offer 99.95% standard for Dedicated; 99.99% available as a paid add-on with a 12-month reserved commitment. I'll run numbers.

Priya Rao: On HSM/BYOK language: propose this counter to the redline: "Customer-managed HSM permitted on Private deployments only. Customer must furnish independent HSM attestation from an accredited assessor within 30 days of go-live. Absent attestation, Redwood will enable Redwood-managed KMS. BYOK/key export requires prior security exception approval." I'll add tracked changes and highlight the attestation timeline.

Emma (security): For the security questionnaire they asked about rotation cadence and escrow. Our standard reply: rotation per NIST SP 800-57 guidance, no escrow unless approved; key custody proof must be provided via secure channel. Link: https://redwood.internal/secure/crypto-kb

Jordan Kim: Finance will accept invoicing to Solstice EU SARL but will keep account on credit hold until PO. Proforma available if they prepay. We can also agree to net45 start date tied to invoice date after PO validation.

docu_sign_bot: DocuSign note: chained envelopes supported. Recommend envelope order: ["billing_contact","legal_counsel","exec_signatory"]. Attach delegation docs to the first envelope. Envelope created (draft): env_solstice_5f4d.

Asha Rao: Customer requested turnaround by EOD Thursday. Priya - can you post counters and route to DocuSign by tomorrow AM? Jordan/Arun - please confirm proforma and ops uplift numbers so I can share with the buyer. I'll request the delegation letter and a sample attestation format from customer. Thanks. :thumbsup:
